title: Commentary on John, Book 20
blurb: Origen’s Commentary on John, Book 20 (later tomoi). Complete on this page: §§1–44.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Commentary on John Book 20 — no previous English translation of these later tomoi (ANF covers only earlier books). This page is Book 20 §§1–44 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Preuschen, Origenes Werke IV (GCS 10, 1903). Heine FOTC was not used as wording. This page is Book 20 §§1–44 of the later books (13, 19, 20, 28, 32).
